item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The figure shows Komal's pictograph of books borrowed on three days. The key says each circle stands for 10 books.

How many more books were borrowed on Wednesday than on Tuesday?

options.A: 20 books, because Wednesday has 2 more circles than Tuesday and each circle is 10 books.
options.B: 2 books, equal to the difference in the number of circles.
options.C: 50 books, equal to Wednesday's total alone.
options.D: 5/3 books, from dividing Wednesday's circle count by Tuesday's.
